codeReview.summary: Solid implementation of four small TUI primitives (EmptyState, LoadingState, StatusBadge, KeybindHint) per component-spec.md. The implementation correctly reuses existing StatusVariant type and helper functions (statusBadgeColor, statusBadgeIcon, center, truncate, runeWidth) from the same package. All 25 MockTerminal tests pass with -race, covering every documented prop combination. 7 snapshot files match the required count (4 StatusBadge variants + 1 per other primitive). StatusBadge variants use four distinct RGB colors from theme tokens (green, amber, red, purple) verified via raw buffer inspection — well beyond bold-vs-not-bold distinction. No determinism violations (no time.Now, rand, os.Getenv). No raw color literals. No changes to mission-boundary files. Worker followed TDD procedure (wrote tests first, confirmed failure, then implemented).

issues.description: KeybindHint compact mode renders the entire 'Key:Desc' string with keyStyle (bold, TextSecondary). The description portion inherits the key's bold styling, which may not match ideal UX where desc should be muted. The component-spec does not explicitly require different styles within the compact string, so this is acceptable but worth noting for future polish.
